---
title: "Temporal Features"
---

![Tempo Distribution vs Baseline](tempo_vs_baseline.png)

## Interpretation

Tempo values in the corpus cluster within a narrower range compared to a broad baseline distribution. While the baseline spans a wide BPM spectrum, the playlist shows a clear concentration around a more limited tempo band.

## What this means

This suggests that the playlist does not reflect random stylistic variation. Instead, it exhibits a constrained tempo profile, indicating a shared rhythmic preference across tracks.

## Connection to the research question

The comparison with a baseline distribution strengthens the argument that rhythmic consistency is not incidental, but a defining characteristic of the corpus.

![Tempo vs Danceability](tempo_danceability.png)

## Interpretation

There is no strong relationship between tempo and danceability. Danceability values remain relatively stable across a wide range of tempos.

## What this means

This indicates that rhythmic feel is not solely determined by tempo. Tracks with different BPM values can still achieve a similar level of perceived groove or movement.

## Connection to the research question

Despite variation in tempo, the consistency in danceability supports the idea that the playlist maintains a stable rhythmic character.

![Track Duration Distribution](duration_distribution.png)

## Interpretation

Track durations are concentrated within a relatively narrow range, with most tracks falling between approximately 2.5 and 4.5 minutes.

## What this means

This suggests a consistent structural format across the playlist. Similar track lengths imply comparable segmentation, such as intro, verse, chorus, and outro sections.

## Connection to the research question

The uniformity in duration reinforces the idea that structural organisation is consistent, even when stylistic elements differ.

## Key Findings

The corpus exhibits **non-random temporal consistency**, where tempo, danceability, and track duration collectively form a stable rhythmic and structural framework. Compared to a broad baseline, tempo values are more concentrated, while danceability remains consistent across tempos and track durations follow a similar structural pattern. Together, these features indicate that temporal organisation acts as a unifying factor within a stylistically diverse playlist.
